summary: This is a routine Form 6-K by Enlivex Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnishing a press release updating its RAIN token holdings and net asset value (NAV) per ordinary share ($66.16 as of July 18, 2026). The filing reports treasury portfolio metrics: 79.55 billion RAIN tokens valued at ~$1.1 billion. There are no special-situation elements—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. It is simply a periodic asset update with no transactional or structural event.
